ralle.settings.title: RALLE Settings
ralle.settings.category.chat.description: Local chat layout and rendering options for any world or server.
ralle.settings.category.raid-lfg.descrip: Alliance Raid LFG access and local notifications.
ralle.settings.option.chat-enabled.descr: Allows RALLE's local chat options to operate in singleplayer or on any server.
ralle.settings.option.edit-chat-layout.d: Opens the HUD layout editor for moving, resizing, or restoring the single chat box.
ralle.settings.option.compact-chat.descr: Collapses consecutive identical messages and displays a repetition count.
Collapses consecutive blank chat lines into one line.
ralle.settings.option.message-direction-: Enables RALLE's selected top-down or bottom-up message direction.
Chooses whether new messages appear from the bottom or the top.
ralle.settings.option.horizontal-alignme: Enables RALLE's selected left or right text alignment.
Chooses whether chat text is aligned to the left or right edge.
ralle.settings.option.text-shadow-enable: Enables RALLE's selected chat text shadow style.
ralle.settings.option.text-shadow.descri: Chooses no shadow, Minecraft's vanilla shadow, or a full shadow.
ralle.settings.option.raid-lfg-enabled.d: Allows RALLE to authenticate and connect to the Kingdom Foxes Raid LFG service after joining Wynncraft.
ralle.settings.option.notification-sound: Plays sounds for RALLE Raid LFG chat notifications.
